title: Propionamide (C<SUB>2</SUB>H<SUB>5</SUB>CONH<SUB>2</SUB>): The Largest Peptide-like Molecule in Space
question: Whether propionamide (C2H5CONH2), the largest peptide-like molecule and next member of the amide chemical family after formamide and acetamide, can be detected in the interstellar medium toward Sgr B2(N).

data.sensitivity: 0.4 to 1 mJy/beam median rms in channel maps

what.value: Laboratory rotational transitions of propionamide in the 21.4-39 GHz range, dipole moment components (mu_a = 0.6359(60) D, mu_b = 3.496(30) D), and fundamental frequency of skeletal torsion mode v30 (45(7) cm-1)

evidence.quote: We started our analysis of propionamide spectrum from the results of Marstokk et al. (1996) where the data in the 21.4 – 39 GHz range were obtained using Stark modulated spectroscopy.
We used dipole moment components obtained by Marstokk et al. (1996) via Stark measurements μ a = 0.6359(60) D and μ b = 3.496(30) D

what.value: Excitation energies of normal vibrational modes of propionamide up to 1000 cm-1

evidence.quote: The excitation energies of all other modes were taken from the study of the vibrational spectrum of propionamide by Kuroda et al. (1972).

what.value: Spectroscopic data for acetamide and acetone, plus JPL and CDMS spectroscopy databases for other molecules

evidence.quote: We built our own Weeds database containing the spectroscopic data of propionamide, acetamide (Ilyushin et al. 2004) and acetone (Ilyushin et al. 2019). The JPL (Pickett et al.1998) and CDMS(Müller et al. 2005; Endresetal.2016) databases are used for other molecules.

external_data.citation: Ilyushin et al. (2004); Ilyushin et al. (2019); Pickett et al. (1998); Müller et al. (2005); Endres et al. (2016)

what.value: N(H2)/N(C18O) abundance ratio in Orion KL (7 x 10^6) and Galactic 16O/18O gradient

evidence.quote: According to the Galactic gradient of [16] O/ [18] O(Wilson & Rood 1994), the abundance ratio of C [18] O is significantly different in the Galactic Center region and the solar neighborhood. We adopt an abundance ratio N(H 2 )/N(C [18] O) two times of that in Orion KL (7 × 10 [6] cm [-2], Castets & Langer (1995)).

recipe.goal: Measure and model laboratory rotational spectrum of propionamide and compute partition function
recipe.method: Measure microwave/mm/sub-mm transitions (9-461 GHz) in three laboratories and fit rotational transitions of ground (v=0) and excited torsional states (v=1) simultaneously with methyl torsion states using the Rho axis method (RAM); calculate rotational and vibrational partition functions.
key_parameters: K_a <= 10, J <= 50 for ground state; F fixed at 5.55 cm^-1; predictions limited to uncertainty < 0.1 MHz
assumptions: Dipole moment components mu_a = 0.6359(60) D and mu_b = 3.496(30) D from Marstokk et al. (1996); vibrational modes up to 1000 cm^-1

recipe.goal: Select low-blending target position Sgr B2(N1E) using integrated intensity maps
recipe.method: Map integrated intensity of the clean 92.143 GHz propionamide line (92142 to 92143.5 MHz) and compare with CH13CN contours to pick a position offset from Sgr B2(N1) where propionamide is strong and blending/continuum opacity is weak.
key_parameters: Selected position 17:47:19.99, -28:22:18.72 (J2000), ~1.5'' east of Sgr B2(N1), region size ~0.3''

recipe.goal: Subtract continuum emission in the image plane
recipe.method: Select 3-5 groups of line-free channels in each spectral window and fit and subtract a first-order baseline in the image plane.
key_parameters: 3-5 groups of line-free channels per spectral window; first-order baseline
assumptions: Continuum emission follows the spectral energy distribution of free-free emission

recipe.goal: Derive C18O and H2 column densities toward Sgr B2(N1E)
recipe.method: Model ALMA C18O spectrum with Weeds under LTE and optically thin assumptions, then scale by adopted N(H2)/N(C18O) ratio.
assumptions: Optically thin emission, LTE, T_ex = 150 K, N(H2)/N(C18O) = 1.4 x 10^7 (two times the Orion KL value of 7 x 10^6)

recipe.goal: Identify and model propionamide and related amide molecules (formamide, acetamide) using LTE synthetic spectra
recipe.method: Fit Gaussian linewidths to clean lines in CLASS, then simulate 3-mm LTE spectral profiles in Weeds for each spectral window separately using custom spectroscopic database plus JPL and CDMS.
key_parameters: Linewidth = 4.2(0.5) km s^-1, T_ex = 150 K, source size ~ 0.3''; same parameters used for v=0 and v=1 states

answer_key.quantity: Column density of propionamide (C2H5CONH2) toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: The column density of propionamide toward Sgr B2(N1E) was derived to be 1.5×10 [16 ] cm [−2], which is three-fifths of that of acetamide, and one-nineteenth of that of formamide.
A column density of 1.5 × 10 [16 ] cm [−2 ] was obtained for propionamide (see Table 4).

answer_key.quantity: Abundance of C2H5CONH2 relative to H2 toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: Abundances relative to H 2 was estimated to be 4.3 × 10 [−9 ] for C 2 H 5 CONH 2 .

answer_key.quantity: Linewidth of C2H5CONH2 toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: With the derived size, a linewidth measurement of 4.2(.5) km s [−1 ] with Gaussian fit of 92.408 and 103.342 GHz lines in CLASS

answer_key.quantity: C18O column density toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: The column density of C O was derived to be 2.5 × 10 [17] cm [-2] .

answer_key.quantity: H2 column density toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: The N(H 2 ) was then calculated to be 3.5 × 10 [24] cm [-2] .

answer_key.quantity: Abundance of CH3CONH2 relative to H2 toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: We derived average abundances relative to H 2 of 7.2 × 10 [−9 ] for CH 3 CONH 2, and 8.0 × 10 [−8 ] for NH 2 CHO.

answer_key.quantity: Abundance of NH2CHO relative to H2 toward Sgr B2(N1E)

evidence.quote: We derived average abundances relative to H 2 of 7.2 × 10 [−9 ] for CH 3 CONH 2, and 8.0 × 10 [−8 ] for NH 2 CHO.
The abundance ratio [C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ]/[CH 3 CONH 2 ] was 0.6, while [CH 3 CONH 2 ]/[NH 2 CHO] was estimated to be ∼ 0.1 toward Sgr B2(N1E).
The abundance ratio [C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ]/[CH 3 CONH 2 ] was 0.6, while [CH 3 CONH 2 ]/[NH 2 CHO] was estimated to be ∼ 0.1 toward Sgr B2(N1E).

answer_key.quantity: Mean column density of C2H5CONH2 toward main Sgr B2(N1) region

evidence.quote: A mean column density of 3.3 × 10 [16 ] cm [−2 ] was obtained for C 2 H 5 CONH 2 .

answer_key.quantity: Abundance ratio [C2H5CONH2]/[CH3CONH2] toward main Sgr B2(N1) region

evidence.quote: The abundance ratio [C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ]/ [CH 3 CONH 2 ] was estimated to be ∼ 0.22, which was lower than that of Sgr B2(N1E).

answer_key.quantity: Abundance ratio [CH3CONH2]/[NH2CHO] toward main Sgr B2(N1) region

evidence.quote: The [CH 3 CONH 2 ]/[NH 2 CHO] is ∼ 0.16 toward the main Sgr B2(N1) region.
